#.label: Tenders (preview)
#.description: Preview of the new tender configuration, for trying out the form in the Config Portal. It is not delivered to the stores. Payment methods (tenders) accepted at the point of sale. Choose the tender type first. Every till, change, refund, limit and rounding setting is offered for every type, except the refund choice and the minimum amounts on cash; the type adds its own settings, such as the currency of a foreign currency or the terminal of a card. 'Cash Drawer', 'Overpayment' (unless 'No Split Payment' is on) and 'Refunds' (except for cash) must be chosen; every other setting left empty uses its default. The technical settings the point of sale needs, such as the payment service settings, provider codes and the store's own currency, are added automatically when the list is delivered to the stores. The 'id' identifies a tender and must be unique in the list.
#/items/properties/id.label: Tender ID
#/items/properties/id.description: Unique code of this tender, 1 to 4 capital letters, digits, '-' or '_'. The point of sale stores at most 4 characters. Transactions, reports and ERP integrations reference it, so never reuse or rename it: renaming creates a new tender. Examples: 'CASH', 'VISA', 'SWSH'. Loyalty redemption and loyalty gift certificates must use the payment code of the loyalty system.
#/items/properties/type.label: Tender Type
#/items/properties/type.description: What kind of payment this is. Choose it first: the other settings depend on it. Changing the type of a tender that is already in use removes the tender from every store and adds it again with the new type.
#/items/properties/type/properties/hardw: How cash is taken. A cash changer machine counts the cash and pays out change by itself, and the till must also have the cash changer enabled. A cash changer tender cannot be the default cash tender: a store with one also needs a cash tender with a cash drawer as its default, for tills without a machine. A cash changer works only when the store's own currency has two decimals. Empty means cash drawer.
#/items/properties/type/properties/termi: How the terminal is connected. An integrated terminal receives the amount from the till; the payment provider is set up for each store and checkout in your payment provider setup, not here. On a standalone terminal the cashier types the amount.
#/items/properties/type/properties/integ: Integrated: the till connects to the payment service, which checks every payment. Standalone: the cashier checks the payment by hand, and the till registers the amount without any check.
#/items/properties/type/properties/provi: The mobile payment service. Required when integrated, ignored when standalone. Swish works only in SEK. The account with the provider is set up and connected before go-live, not here.
#/items/properties/type/properties/credi: When on, the till checks the business customer on the sale and their credit limit before accepting the tender. When off, the tender is accepted without any customer or credit check.
#/items/properties/currency.label: Currency
#/items/properties/currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the foreign currency, for example 'EUR'. Required for foreign currency cash, and ignored for every other type, which uses the store's own currency. It must be one of the currencies configured for the stores and differ from the store's own currency.
#/items/properties/name.label: Display Name
#/items/properties/name.description: Shown on the till and printed on receipts. Examples: 'Cash', 'Visa / Mastercard', 'Swish'.
#/items/properties/description.label: Internal Description
#/items/properties/description.descripti: Note for administrators. Not shown to cashiers or customers.
#/items/properties/disabled.label: Disabled
#/items/properties/disabled.description: Removes the tender from the stores but keeps its configuration here, so it can be enabled again. A disabled tender cannot be the change tender of another tender.
#/items/properties/behavior.label: At the Till
#/items/properties/behavior.description: How the till handles this tender. 'Cash Drawer', and 'Overpayment' unless 'No Split Payment' is on, must be chosen; every other setting is optional and left empty uses its default.
#/items/properties/behavior/properties/d: The till uses the default tender of a type when a payment names only the type, and the default cash tender decides the store's change and cash rounding. Automatic (default): this tender becomes the default when no enabled tender of its type is set to 'Yes' and it is the only enabled one of its type not set to 'No'. Cash changer tenders are left out of this count and are never the default cash tender. When a type has several enabled tenders, set 'Yes' on exactly one of them, or 'No' on all but one. Foreign currency is the exception: with several foreign currency tenders the till always asks the cashier which currency, and Yes only pre-selects that currency in the list, so none has to be Yes.
#/items/properties/behavior/properties/o: Whether the customer can pay more than the amount due with this tender, and whether the difference is given back as change. Required, except with 'No Split Payment', which always takes the exact amount. Usual choice: 'Allowed, give change' for cash, foreign currency, gift certificates, vouchers and checks, and 'Exact amount only' for the other types. 'Allowed, no change' keeps the overpaid amount, for example a voucher worth more than the purchase; the cashier confirms before the sale completes. Change goes to the store's default cash tender or to the change tender on the Change tab.
#/items/properties/behavior/properties/e: When on, this tender must pay the whole amount due on its own: no other tender may be on the sale, and it always takes the exact amount, whatever 'Overpayment' says. A tender with a fixed value, such as a gift certificate, voucher or coupon, can then only be used when its value equals the amount due.
#/items/properties/behavior/properties/l: When on, no items can be added, changed or discounted once this tender is entered, and the sale cannot be suspended. The sale can still be completed, the payment removed, or the sale cancelled. Together with 'Block Removing the Payment', the sale can only be finished by paying it in full, even when the customer cannot pay.
#/items/properties/behavior/properties/b: When on, a payment with this tender cannot be removed from the sale once entered, so the sale cannot be cancelled either. The sale can only be completed, or suspended with a manager override. Together with 'Lock Sale After Payment Entry', the sale can only be finished by paying it in full.
#/items/properties/behavior/properties/p: When on and no amount is given, the till uses the full remaining amount and skips the amount prompt. Intended for terminals and unmanned checkouts. On foreign currency the till then accepts only the exact converted amount, so a customer paying with a larger note gets no change. A cash changer tender always takes the full remaining amount.
When on, the amount prompt on interactive tills starts with the remaining amount instead of zero.
#/items/properties/behavior/properties/c: Whether the cash drawer opens when a sale paid with this tender is completed. Required. Usual choice: open for cash, foreign currency, gift certificates, vouchers, checks, coupons and manufacturer coupons, which go into the drawer, and closed for the other types. Choose 'Open the drawer' for paper food stamps and WIC checks; electronic benefit cards need no drawer. Change given in cash always opens the drawer.
#/items/properties/change.label: Change
#/items/properties/change.description: Where change goes when the customer pays more than the amount due. Every setting here is optional: leave them empty to give all change in cash, in the store's default cash tender. Used only when 'Overpayment' is 'Allowed, give change'.
#/items/properties/change/properties/ten: Leave empty to give change in cash, in the store's default cash tender. Otherwise, the tender that pays change instead, for example a gift certificate that issues the remainder as a new certificate. It may be this tender itself. It must be an enabled tender in this list, neither loyalty points nor an integrated mobile payment, that allows refunds, has no minimum refund and no minimum per entry, and does not have 'No Split Payment' on: change is paid as a refund with that tender, and the sale cannot complete if the refund is refused. Its maximum refund also limits change: above it, a manager must approve. An integrated mobile payment refuses a refund without its original payment, so it cannot pay change. With an integrated card, the payment provider must accept a refund to the presented card without an original payment. Most do, but some providers must turn it on for the merchant account, and some card types and wallets are declined. With an integrated electronic gift card, the cashier scans the card that receives the change, unless the change tender has 'giftCardProductCode' (see 'Extra Attributes'): then a new virtual gift card receives it.
#/items/properties/change/properties/thr: Change above this amount goes to the change tender; this amount or less is given in cash. Leave empty to give all change in the change tender. Ignored without a change tender.
#/items/properties/change/properties/aut: Change below this amount is given automatically. From this amount up, the cashier must handle the change before the sale completes. Leave empty to always give change automatically.
#/items/properties/refund.label: Refunds
#/items/properties/refund.description: Whether money can go back to the customer with this tender, and the limits for it. 'Refunds' must be chosen, except for cash.
#/items/properties/refund/properties/ref: Whether this tender can be used when money goes back to the customer. Required, except for cash, which always allows refunds because change is paid out as a cash refund. Usual choice: blocked for checks, coupons, manufacturer coupons, food stamps, WIC checks, loyalty points, standalone mobile payments and standalone electronic gift cards, where nothing checks the payment; allowed for the other types. A loyalty points refund needs a loyalty customer on the sale.
#/items/properties/refund/properties/ski: Skip Amount Prompt on Receipt Refunds
When on, a refund against the original receipt refunds the remaining amount of this tender without asking the cashier for an amount.
#/items/properties/refund/properties/max: Largest amount that can go back to the customer in one entry with this tender. Above it, a manager must approve. On cash this also limits change. Leave empty for no limit. Ignored when refunds are blocked.
#/items/properties/refund/properties/min: Smallest amount that can go back to the customer in one entry with this tender. Must not be larger than the maximum. Ignored for cash, where it would block change. Leave empty for no minimum.
#/items/properties/limits.label: Amount Limits
#/items/properties/limits.description: Limits on how much can be paid with this tender. Leave a limit empty for no limit.
#/items/properties/limits/properties/max: Largest total that can be paid with this tender in one sale, over all its entries.
Largest amount for a single entry of this tender.
#/items/properties/limits/properties/min: Smallest amount for a single entry of this tender, including change and refunds paid with it. A remaining amount below it cannot be paid with this tender. Must not be larger than the maximums. Ignored for cash, where it would block change.
#/items/properties/rounding.label: Rounding
#/items/properties/rounding.description: Rounds amounts paid with this tender, for example to the smallest coin in use. Leave empty, or choose 'No rounding', for no rounding. A tender that gives no overpayment pays the amount due rounded to its unit: rounded up, the difference is booked as rounding; rounded down, the rest must be paid with another tender, unless the default cash tender's rounding takes it to zero. With 'No Split Payment' on, use no unit coarser than the store's cash rounding: the tender must pay exactly the order total.
#/items/properties/rounding/properties/m: Whether amounts are rounded, and how. 'Round half up' and 'Round half down' round to the nearest unit and differ only for an amount exactly between two units. 'Round down' rounds every amount toward zero to the unit, for example 10.37 becomes 10.35 with unit 0.05, and a refund of 10.37 also becomes 10.35. A till installation can be set to round up instead.
#/items/properties/rounding/properties/p: The smallest unit amounts are rounded to, for example 0.05 or 1. Amounts the cashier types must be a multiple of it. It must be a multiple of the smallest unit of the store's currency, for example not 0.025 in a currency with two decimals. Ignored without a rounding method or with 'No rounding'.
#/items/properties/extraAttributes.label: Extra Attributes
#/items/properties/extraAttributes.descr: Raw checkout settings for cases this form does not cover. Use them only when support asks for it; 'giftCardProductCode', described at the end, is the exception. Each entry is identified by its name ('id'). A name for a setting this form offers, or for one that is added automatically, such as the payment service settings or the provider code, is refused. Other names are passed to the checkout as written, and must match the setting's name exactly, including upper and lower case; a name with spaces at either end is refused. On an integrated electronic gift card tender, 'giftCardProductCode', with the gift card product code as value, makes a refund create a new virtual gift card instead of asking for a card number. No setting keeps a tender out of payments: the till also offers this tender for payment, and a payment with it then uses the product code and does not ask for the customer's card. Add it only to a separate tender for refunds, for example 'Gift Card Refund', and take gift card payments with a tender without it; the cashier chooses the right one.
